name: DuckDuckGo SERP
body: (function () { var out = []; var nodes = document.querySelectorAll("article[data-testid='result'], .result"); for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) { var n = nodes[i]; var a = n.querySelector("a[data-testid='result-title-a']") || n.querySelector('.result__a') || n.querySelector('a[href^=http]'); if (!a || !a.href) continue; var s = n.querySelector("[data-result='snippet']") || n.querySelector('.result__snippet'); out.push({ title: (a.innerText || a.textContent || '').trim(), url: a.href, snippet: ((s && (s.innerText || s.textContent)) || '').trim() }); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()
